newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares touch lower, may show gains.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares touch lower, may show gains.

text.p: Shares dipped slightly by the close on Tuesday but brokers said that some major issues, although stable for the moment, may show small gains.
The official list slipped 0.18 points to 897.5 points while the broader group A index edged up 0.18 points to 1876.94. Central market turnover was 618,032 litas from 405,386 litas.
"At the moment, prices are quite accessible for sellers and
buyers but I think they are still a little low," the dealer said, adding this meant a slight upturn may come through.
Vilniaus Bank and Hermis Bank, which spearheaded a mild recovery in prices last week, were stable.
Vilniaus Bank closed unchanged at 230 litas on the central market but saw no turnover.
"The price should stay about the same, with slight fluctuations, this week," said one broker.
Hermis Bank shares held steady at 190 litas on the central market, turning over 95,000 litas.
Brokers say demand in Hermis Bank is still strong enough to push it a little higher but are split over whether it will top 200 litas this week.
Despite positive results all year, Hermis Bank has languished on the depressed Vilnius bourse until recently.

Brokers said they are watching Hermis and other shares like Rokishkis Cheese, Klaipeda Stevedoring Company (KLASCO) and Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company (LISCO), which they say will out-perform the market in the long run.
Rokishkis slipped to 41.10 litas from 42.50, which brokers blamed on the weak market, and said it would move back to a range of 42 litas to 44 litas.
KLASCO was unchanged at 12 litas and LISCO stayed put at 6.25 litas.
